fictional_only.instruction: A live-action character remains the fictional character. Do not import performer biography, relationships, real-world mannerisms or identity.

special_blocks: Billy Batson/Shazam: adult-looking transformed body does not change child mind/personhood

jasper_pov.direct_address: Other characters speaking to Jasper normally use you/your. This is dialogue grammar, not second-person narration.
lint: Outside dialogue, Jasper narrates self only as I/me/my/mine/myself.
Do not mechanically alternate they/she every sentence.
Use Jasper to reset an ambiguous third-person antecedent.

hard_explicit.rule: Explicitness must become more concrete without collapsing every character into the same porn vocabulary.

canon_state_handling: Canon-married/partnered characters require AU, canon divergence or consensual poly setup as selected.
Canon-deceased characters require pre-death era or canon divergence for ongoing romance.
Non-romanceable game NPCs are clearly labeled transformative rather than quietly treated as canon romance options.
continuation_engine_rules: Load selected character profile(s) plus latest continuation-context ledger before writing a continuation.
Never restart courtship milestones already completed.
Preserve character-specific diction through explicit scenes.
Track who knows each secret and never grant off-page knowledge without cause.
Carry emotional/physical aftermath and aftercare forward where relevant.
pool_selection_rules: Use index.json to diversify retrieval rather than repeatedly choosing the same famous characters.
Prioritize strong fit but allow adjacent archetypes to keep the pool varied.
Lower default weight for dark/villain profiles unless the prompt requests that tone.
Canon-romanceable status is not required for transformative fanfiction, but married/partnered/deceased/non-romanceable status must remain visible to planning.
Use character_id rather than display name as the unique key because different fandoms can contain characters with the same name.
